# Vishome Carpet

Vishome Carpet is the website for Vishome Global Commercial Carpet Co., Ltd., a Tianjin, China-based B2B commercial carpet manufacturer.

Core product focus:
- Commercial carpet tiles for offices, hotels, commercial buildings, and public spaces
- Wall-to-wall broadloom carpet for hotel guestrooms, corridors, lobbies, ballrooms, and hospitality projects
- Public area carpet for airports, exhibition centers, retail, galleries, and high-traffic interiors
- Natural sisal commercial carpet and custom printed hotel carpet
- OEM and ODM carpet manufacturing for international distributors, contractors, hotel groups, designers, and project buyers
